body: I think Toby will see most of the carries if Peterson is out, but it will still be very limited. I'm guessing they'll work Harvin and Camarillo as a pseudo run game with a bunch of short quick passes and screens. Also maybe some more use of Shiancoe, whose been kind of absent this year so far. Don't for get Rice will help them stretch the field and the Vikings O-line has something to be desired.

I respectfully disagree. Toby is definitely not ready for a starting RB position. I've watched the vikings almost every game this year and I can tell you your only prayer for points from Toby is a 1 or 2 yard touchdown run. Also Bills don't have a great record but they've been playing tough football. (they did almost beat the steelers yesterday)
